title: ANDI
description: EEG recordings from 17 male participants performing a guided visual search task while simultaneously completing a binaurally presented auditory N-back task. The design includes a baseline condition in which the auditory stimuli were ignored, and dual-task conditions with N-back levels of 0, 1 and 2, which vary auditory working memory load. The dataset includes 64-channel BioSemi EEG with EOG and mastoid reference channels and is annotated with HED.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system at 512 Hz. Four external electrodes recorded bipolar horizontal and vertical EOG, and one external electrode on each mastoid provided reference signals. In the visual task, participants followed a red annulus and pressed a button if it stopped at a prespecified target. In the auditory task, they judged whether spoken numbers, presented about every 2 seconds, matched the number N items earlier.
